hints.title: Core Idea
hints.text: Check if the three side lengths form a valid triangle using the triangle inequality: a + b > c, b + c > a, and a + c > b.

hints.title: Algorithmic Steps
hints.text: If all three sides are equal, return 'equilateral'. If exactly two sides are equal, return 'isosceles'. Otherwise, return 'scalene'.

hints.title: Implementation

complexity.notes: Sorting 3 elements and evaluating side-length conditions.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Not checking triangle inequality before classifying leads to incorrect triangle types.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Always enforce strict triangle inequality before checking equality of sides.
